name: Kozuki Ryouya
source:
Ryouya Kozuki is Shin'ichirou and Soushi's older brother. He has a psychiatric clinic and he does double-personalities-analysis to Sora and Sunao (with Soushi and Nanami's approval, though the same can not be said for the boys).

[From [url=https://sukisho.fandom.com/wiki/Ryouya_Kozuki]Sukisho Wiki[/url]]
